author: Fatima Bhutto
content:

Less than a week after September 11, 2001, George W. Bush went to a mosque in
Washington, DC, and declared that "[Islam is peace](https://georgewbush-
whitehouse.archives.gov/news/releases/2001/09/20010917-11.html)." He then
proceeded to invade two Muslim countries that had nothing to do with the
attacks on the twin towers in 2001.

9/11 changed the world, and it did so in two dramatic ways.
